name: Settlement Transaction Status Type 2
definition: Choice of the securities settlement instruction status type.

ProcessingStatus.name: Processing Status
ProcessingStatus.definition: Provides details on the processing status of the transaction.

InferredMatchingStatus.name: Inferred Matching Status
InferredMatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of an instruction as known by the account servicer based on an allegement. At this time no matching took place on the market (at the CSD/ICSD).

MatchingStatus.name: Matching Status
MatchingStatus.definition: Provides the matching status of the instruction.

SettlementStatus.name: Settlement Status
SettlementStatus.definition: Provides the settlement status of a transaction.

Settled.name: Settled
Settled.definition: Defines that the transaction has been settled.
